text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Huh! This zoo got renovated, huh?
Not bad at all!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hm? This isn't Tokyo...?
Well, I'll manage somehow.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Where the heck am I...?
I was just walking aimlessly,
and wound up in a place like this...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
There ain't no buildings at all,
so I got no idea which way to go...!
Dammit, I'd never get lost in Tokyo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having lost her way outside the city where she wasn't used to being, Jungle Pocket ended up wandering around until she was completely exhausted.
